Now it silences the clock. You flip Do Not Disturb before a deep block, the way you have a thousand times. The phone goes quiet. Notifications stop. Every device you own agrees that you are working, and the one thing still talking to you is the clock in the corner of your own Mac, which is the interruption nobody ever gave you a switch for. Nocturne is that switch, and as of 1.3.0 you do not have to touch it. Turn on a Focus anywhere in your ecosystem, from your iPhone, from the Watch, from Control Center, and your Mac's menu bar goes with it. Turn the Focus off and it comes back exactly as it was. [](/dotcomjack/nocturne/blob/main/docs/clockbeforeafter.png) macOS 14 or later. No permissions. No private APIs. No account. Around 3,500 lines of Swift, of which roughly a third is the comments explaining what was measured and why. The part worth stealing even if you never install this You cannot hide the macOS menu bar clock. Not with a checkbox, and not with any of the defaults incantations that turn up when you search for it. The clock is the one menu bar item Apple gives no visibility toggle. In System Settings under Menu Bar, Siri, Spotlight, WiFi, Bluetooth, Battery and AirDrop all have a checkbox. Clock has a Clock Options button and nothing else. Three widely repeated tricks are dead. Measured on macOS 26.3.1 by reading the onscreen width of Control Center's Clock window before and after each write: Approach Clock width Baseline, Sat Aug 8 2:43 AM 142pt defaults currentHost write com.apple.controlcenter Clock int 8 142pt, no effect defaults write com.apple.controlcenter "NSStatusItem VisibleCC Clock" bool false 142pt, no effect defaults write com.apple.menuextra.clock DateFormat string " " 142pt, no effect defaults write com.apple.menuextra.clock IsAnalog bool true 44pt _HIHideMenuBar and AutoHideMenuBarOption do not work either. Both store fine, and System Settings reads the value back correctly, but neither applies without a logout, which makes them useless for a toggle. So the trick is not to hide the clock. It is to make it unreadable. An analog dial at 44pt still tells the time, in the sense that a sundial in another room tells the time. Your eye stops catching it, and nothing is hidden, moved, or drawn over. Measure, do not screenshot. Every number above came from CGWindowListCopyWindowInfo, reading the clock window's width directly. Sleepandscreenshot lied twice during development: Control Center takes a few seconds to repopulate after a restart, and a screenshot taken during that gap shows an empty menu bar that looks exactly like a successful hide. And the window list has a trap in it. kCGWindowBounds is free to read, but kCGWindowName is gated behind Screen Recording. An early version of the locator filtered on name == "Clock" and appeared to work perfectly, because it was being launched
items.author: dotcomjack
items.descZh: Nocturne 是一款专为 macOS 设计的菜单栏时钟隐藏工具，解决了一个长期被忽视的系统痛点：苹果未为菜单栏时钟提供原生可见性切换开关。核心功能是通过将数字时钟替换为 44pt 的模拟表盘，让时间信息在视觉上变得"不可读"，而非真正移除时钟图标，从而绕过系统的功能限制。亮点方面，该工具在 macOS 26.3.1 上经过实测验证，证实 `defaults write` 三种常见方法（设置 `Clock int 8`、`NSStatusItem VisibleCC Clock bool false`、修改 `DateFormat`）均无法缩小 142pt 的时钟宽度；项目共约 3,500 行 Swift 代码，其中约三分之一为注释，自 1.3.0 版本起支持与 iPhone、Apple Watch 及控制中心的 Focus 模式自动联动；完全无需任何系统权限、私有 API 或账号。适用场景包括需要进入深度专注工作、开启免打扰模式、追求极简菜单栏美感的 macOS 用户，以及对 macOS 系统隐藏机制感兴趣的工程师。
items.quote: 诀窍不是隐藏时钟，而是让它不可读。
items.titleZh: Show HN：Nocturne，可隐藏 Mac 菜单栏时钟，或只隐藏除时钟以外的全部内容

items.title: Show HN: OpenMonitor – vendor neutral web monitoring cloud agent
items.desc: description: A durable web monitoring agent. Vendor neutral: bring any search API key. Runs on a schedule, talks to you on Slack. title: OpenMonitor A durable web monitoring agent. Vendor neutral. Bring any search API key. It runs on a schedule, filters results against a sentence you write, and talks to you on Slack. [Deploy to OpenComputer](https://app.opencomputer.dev/template?repositoryurl=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fdiggerhq%2Fopenmonitor) an [OpenComputer](https://docs.opencomputer.dev/agents/overview) template. One click, your account, your key. Exa · Parallel · Tavily · Brave · Serper · Firecrawl · Jina · Perplexity · Linkup · You.com · Kagi · Valyu · Monid Or let your coding agent do it One prompt. It installs the CLI, signs you in, deploys the agent, and walks you through connecting it as a Slack app. Claude Code Codex Grok OpenCode Copies the prompt. Paste it into your coding agent. See the prompt389 words Set up OpenMonitor for me: https://github.com/diggerhq/openmonitor. It is a web monitoring agent that runs on OpenComputer and talks to me on Slack. Do every step yourself; only stop to ask me for things only I can provide (signin, API key, what to watch, Slack app credentials). Never echo my keys back to me and never commit them. 1. Install the CLI: npm i g @opencomputer/cli. Run opencomputer login and give me the signin link. Confirm with opencomputer whoami. 2. git clone https://github.com/diggerhq/openmonitor && cd openmonitor && npm install, then npx opencomputer link createproject openmonitor. 3. Ask me which search provider to use (exa, parallel, tavily, brave, serper, firecrawl, jina, perplexity, linkup, you, kagi, valyu, monid) and for its API key. Only that one key is needed. For development and then production: printf %s <provider npx opencomputer env set SEARCH_PROVIDER valuestdin environment <env and printf %s "<key" npx opencomputer secrets set <SECRET_NAME valuestdin environment <env. Secret names are listed in opencomputer/.env.example. 4. Ask me what I want to watch. Edit opencomputer/agents/monitor/watches.ts: one entry per watch with a query and a onesentence criteria. Run npx opencomputer doctor, then npx opencomputer deploy alias development. 5. Test it: npx opencomputer session "Refresh every watch, 24 hour lookback." agent openmonitor. Show me the report. Fix anything that fails before going on. 6. Connect Slack for development: run scripts/slack.sh start development. It writes slackmanifest.development.json and prints the steps. Then walk me through them: open https://api.slack.com/apps, Create New App, From a manifest, pick my workspace, paste the manifest JSON, create it, then Install to Workspace. Ask me for the App ID and Signing Secret (Basic Information) and the Bot User OAuth Token (OAuth & Permissions). Run SLACK_APP_ID=… SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET=… SLACK_BOT_TOKEN=… scripts/slack.sh complete development. 7. Tell me to invite the bot to the Slack channel that should get alerts (/invite @OpenMonitor) and to send you that channel's ID (open channel details, it is at the bottom and starts with C). Run scripts/slack.sh bind development <ID, then scripts/slack.sh status development and confirm it is connected. 8. Tell me to @mention the bot in that channel with "what can you do" and to DM it "run the watches now". When I confirm it replied, deploy to production with npx opencomputer deploy alias production and repeat steps 6 and 7 with production. The daily schedule only runs in production.
items.author: iacguy
items.descZh: OpenMonitor 是一个基于 OpenComputer 平台的网页监控代理，强调"供应商中立"和"持久运行"，让用户可携带任意搜索 API 密钥进行部署。它按计划定时执行监控任务，通过用户自定义的一句话过滤标准对结果进行筛选，并通过 Slack 将警报推送给用户。文章重点展示了一键部署和编程代理（coding agent）两种集成方式：一键部署只需登录账户并填入密钥即可上线；编程代理方式则通过一条完整的多步骤提示词，让 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 或 OpenCode 等代理自动完成 CLI 安装、登录、项目克隆、环境配置、监控规则编写、测试、Slack 应用创建与绑定，直到部署到开发与生产环境。该提示词覆盖了 13 种可选搜索提供商（Exa、Parallel、Tavily、Brave、Serper、Firecrawl、Jina、Perplexity、Linkup、You.com、Kagi、Valyu、Monid），并明确规范了密钥保管、Slack OAuth 凭据处理及每日定时任务（仅在生产环境生效）等安全与运维细节。适用场景包括需要持续追踪竞品动态、新闻舆情、价格变动、技术博客更新或行业信号的企业团队与个人开发者，尤其适合已经在使用 Slack 进行协作、并希望以低代码方式接入多种搜索后端的用户。
items.quote: 一款持久稳定的网页监控代理。供应商中立：可接入任意搜索 API 密钥。按计划定时运行，并通过 Slack 与你对话。
items.titleZh: Show HN：OpenMonitor —— 厂商中立的网络监控云代理

items.descZh: Undercolony 是一款基于浏览器的大规模多人在线(MMO)蚂蚁模拟游戏，将现实世界中的蚂蚁觅食行为数字化,玩家通过跑步/移动来贡献"米数",为整个蚁群搬运物资到蚁后那里。核心玩法包括选择职业(护士、工蚁、觅食者、兵蚁、突袭蚁)、加入或创建"地下殖民地"、发布发现的资源,以及与全球其他玩家协作完成搬运任务,排行榜和殖民地米数榜(如"野餐桌"殖民地以 6028 米领先)展现了持续运营的社交竞争机制。亮点在于真实步数换算成游戏进度、完全免费、跨平台且数据持久化的"all caps"全大写拟物化界面设计,营造出荒诞又上瘾的协作氛围。适用场景为碎片化时间锻炼、寻找轻量级社交合作玩法的玩家,以及对怪奇独立游戏感兴趣的休闲群体。整体而言,它把健身、众包协作和蚂蚁叙事巧妙融合,堪称"跑步机版蚁群模拟器"。
items.quote: 一款大型多人蚂蚁模拟游戏。觅食、记录发现，并和同伴一起将食物举回蚁穴，献给蚁后。

items.author: Touchnow
items.descZh: TouchNow 是一款为 Mac 用户设计的远程虚拟游戏控制器，旨在解决外出时无法流畅游玩 Mac 游戏的痛点。随着 macOS 对游戏支持日益增多，作者开发此工具以便在移动场景下远程操控家中 Mac 进行游戏。其核心功能是通过虚拟手柄远程控制 Mac，并支持根据不同游戏自定义按键布局。该应用体现了 Mac 游戏生态向移动化、个性化扩展的趋势。亮点在于自定义控制器布局功能，让玩家能为各类游戏优化操作体验。适用场景为拥有 Mac 游戏设备但希望外出时继续游玩的玩家，特别是经常出差或通勤的用户。
